title: Accidental mass DELETE recovered with RDS PITR

events.event: BAD CHANGE: DELETE FROM customers WHERE country = 'GB' committed
availability SLO unaffected: the service is up, the data is wrong
decision: point-in-time restore to 1 s before the DELETE
cutover step 1: stop writes (API + loadgen to 0)
writes on the old instance after the restore point
cutover step 2: post-restore-point inserts reconciled into restored instance
cutover step 3: repoint API and backups to the restored instance
recovered: 10 consecutive successful probe write+read cycles
